msg: Olá! Somos um casal do Brasil e queremos fazer snorkel. Quanto custa e como reservamos?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Snorkeling in the Rosario Islands is a lovely way to enjoy the Caribbean reef together. I’m leaving the price options below for departures from Cartagena and for guests already on the islands.

You can check the tour details and book here: https://divingplanet.org/tours-buceo-snorkel-cartagena/tour-snorkeling/

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: From Cartagena, next Thursday. We are Brazilian, two people. Is that the booking link?
reply:
Yes—the link I shared earlier was not the correct booking link. For your snorkeling tour from Cartagena, use this official link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

Choose next Thursday and 2 people in the booking calendar. The tour includes round-trip boat transport, snorkeling equipment, two guided sessions, lunch, park entrance and activity insurance. Meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; transport to the dock isn’t included. As Brazilian guests, payment is by foreign card on the website.

🤿 *Snorkeling Tour*
💰 *126 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, activity insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided sessions with a local guide, snorkeling equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
